fixtures.author: Project QA

generationRecipe.instructions: Locally generate exactly the 39 bytes in bytesHex using Buffer.from(bytesHex, 'hex') and write them unchanged to corrupt.bin. They encode the Latin1 string Q02 intentionally invalid image bytes followed by bytes 00 and FF; no external download.

fixtures.modifications: Deterministic non-image Latin1 byte string, including NUL and FF.

fixtures.title: Q02 deterministic pixel-limit.png
fixtures.author: Project QA

generationRecipe.instructions: Locally generate PNG signature 89504e470d0a1a0a followed by IHDR, one IDAT and empty IEND. IHDR is 13 bytes: big-endian width8001, height8000, bit depth8, grayscale color type0, compression0, filter0, interlace0. Write8000 identical scanlines, each8002 zero bytes (filter byte0 plus8001 black grayscale pixels), sequentially into Node24.14.0 createDeflate({level:9}) with other zlib defaults, and concatenate compressed output as the single IDAT. Each chunk is big-endian data length, four ASCII type bytes, data, and big-endian CRC32 of type+data. Stream rows with backpressure; never allocate the full64,008,000pixel raster. The W3C URL is a format reference only; no external download.

fixtures.attribution: Project QA dedicates these deterministic boundary fixture bytes to CC0-1.0; no hardware photograph or model-quality claim.
fixtures.modifications: Deterministic8001x8000 grayscale black PNG; filter0 zero rows; zlib level9; valid CRC chunks and complete IDAT,64,008,000pixels. Generated scanline-by-scanline without large raster allocation.
fixtures.visualVerdict: Generated technical boundary input only. Not a photograph.
